prompt:
90 年代中国港式武侠漫画美术风格，2.5D 漫画质感，
墨线分明清晰，厚涂上色、色彩饱和鲜艳明亮，
人物五官立体，衣袂飘动有动势，
整体明亮通透、光影对比鲜明、阳光感强、色彩活力充沛，
保持暖色调与冷色调的鲜明对比，避免整体灰暗压抑。

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2D wuxia RPG combat visual-effect sprite sheet.
Primary request: a four-frame sword aura attack effect for 林西基础剑法·一式.
Layout: a strict 2 by 2 grid, each cell exactly one 512 by 512 frame, no borders, no labels, no frame numbers. Read left-to-right, then top-to-bottom.
Frame 1: compact cyan-white sword aura gathering, low intensity.
Frame 2: a sharp diagonal sword arc traveling from lower-left to upper-right.
Frame 3: bright impact starburst at the upper-right end of the slash, with a few controlled sparks.
Frame 4: fading thin cyan trails and two small particles, clearly less bright than frame 3.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background across every cell.
Constraints: effect only, no character, no weapon, no text, no UI, no watermark, no shadows, no ground plane; keep all pixels inside the safe padding of each frame; consistent hand-painted 2.5D wuxia comic effect, bright cyan-white core with cool blue edges.
Avoid: fire, skulls, lightning, realistic smoke, photorealism, extra panels, black background, any #FF00FF within the effect, 现代服装，3D CG 渲染感，照片级写实，
网络红人脸，二次元萌系，迪士尼风，
水印，签名，文字乱码，
繁体中文，繁体字，traditional chinese characters，
错字，简化字写错，
整体灰暗，雾蒙蒙，低饱和，沉郁压抑，黯淡无光，灰蒙蒙的色调
